data.name: Avran
data.gender_notes: Avran is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Avran is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Varun'. Varun is the Hindu god of water and the preserver of the universe. Avran signifies the one who controls and protects the rain, ensuring abundant harvests and prosperity. The name Avran carries the meaning “Lord of Rain” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Avran usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of rain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Avran belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Rain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Avran total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
